headline: Colombian Merchants Urge Elimination of 40% Tariff on Imported Clothing
summary: The National Federation of Merchants of Colombia (Fenalco) asked President Abelardo de la Espriella's administration to eliminate a 40% tariff on imported apparel and establish competitive parity with platforms like Temu and Shein.
why: Import tariffs in emerging markets shape consumer price inflation and trade patterns. Tariff modifications directly affect domestic retailers and cross-border e-commerce supply chains.

impacts.name: Colombian Retail
impacts.why: Eliminating tariffs would lower apparel import costs but intensify competition for domestic textile makers.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
